summary: 25-year-old woman fell 30-50 ft over talus and snow descending from Ellingwood Point toward the Ellingwood-Blanca saddle (~noon); lacerations to her lower leg, two sprained ankles, bruising. Self-rescue with her partner and three bystanders stalled near Blue Lake when she grew ataxic; AVSAR hasty team plus a 5-tech team reached her ~2025 hrs and ground-transported her to the Lake Como command post by midnight, then to San Luis Valley Regional Medical Center.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Alamosa County Sheriff's Office
notes: AVSAR 2010 archive narrative; partner was a 24-year-old woman; 911 call requested the rescue
